# Computational Methods for Numerical Analysis

> The living web companion to *Computational Methods for Numerical Analysis with R* by James P. Howard, II, with methods, code, browser laboratories, teaching resources, worked examples, errata, and continuing project updates.

Website: https://cmna.jameshoward.us/
Creator: James P. Howard, II
Primary book: *Computational Methods for Numerical Analysis with R* (Chapman & Hall/CRC, 2017)

## Main content

- [Book](https://cmna.jameshoward.us/book/): information about the book and its relationship to the companion site.
- [Methods](https://cmna.jameshoward.us/methods/): numerical-method atlas and method-specific explanations.
- [Laboratory](https://cmna.jameshoward.us/laboratory/): browser-based interactive numerical-analysis demonstrations.
- [R Workbench](https://cmna.jameshoward.us/workbench/): client-side R environment powered by webR.
- [Teaching](https://cmna.jameshoward.us/teaching/): course maps, instructional notes, exercises, worksheets, and adoption material.
- [Software](https://cmna.jameshoward.us/software/): companion software and canonical implementations.
- [Numerical Zoo](https://cmna.jameshoward.us/zoo/): canonical problems selected for interesting numerical behavior and failure modes.
- [Updates](https://cmna.jameshoward.us/updates/): project news and continuing additions.
- [Cite](https://cmna.jameshoward.us/cite/): citation guidance for the book and companion material.

## Interpretation notes

This site supports the published book; it is not presented as a separate replacement textbook or as an announced second edition. Interactive laboratories are teaching visualizations. Browser-side R computation runs locally through WebAssembly rather than on a CMNA computation server.

## Related

- [James Howard](https://jameshoward.us/): author profile, scholarship, teaching, and related projects.
